title: autotune: default batching/caching + quantization profile suggestions + unit-econ tool integration
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce per-token cost for common production workloads by shipping safe defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching, plus model-specific quantization profile recommendations and tight integration with the unit-economics (UE) tool. This PR wires autotune suggestions into the Optimize pipeline so customers get actionable, testable defaults on project onboarding and during periodic audits. Changes include: heuristic and telemetry-driven defaults for request batching and KV cache TTLs/config (server + SDK hints); quantization-profile metadata on model entries and a small profiler that suggests int8/4-bit candidates based on perf/quality profiles; UE tool integration: cost delta estimates are surfaced in the console and returned via the API when suggestions are applied; migration path and backward-compatible flags so existing Dedicated/Private deployments keep current behavior unless opt-in.

release_notes: Adds conservative autotune defaults for batching and KV caching, model quantization profile suggestions, and unit-economics estimates integrated in the Optimize surface. Rollout is opt-in for Dedicated/Private. See docs for migration flags and operator guidance.
review_comments: Michael Zhang: Left a few nits on the heuristics and suggested reducing the default batch window from 100ms to 75ms for low-latency tiers.
Asha Patel: Responded - changed to 75ms for tier=low_latency and added a config flag to override globally. Added unit test for the tier switch.
Lucia Gomez: Asked for more clarity in the console copy about 'estimated savings' disclaimers. Requested a tooltip explaining variance and canary requirement.
Asha Patel: Added tooltip copy and linked to docs; updated e2e to assert tooltip exists.

Ravi Menon: Noted a potential race in cache eviction when TTLs are adjusted; requested an integration test. Asha Patel: Added integration test in perf-canary and a conservative backoff to TTL updates.
tests_summary: Unit tests: 48 passed, 2 skipped. Integration: 8 new tests added; perf-canary synthetic workloads show median p50 latency within SLA; UE estimates matched offline ground truth within 7% on sampled workloads.
notes: We intentionally keep quantization recommendations as suggestions (not auto-applied) due to potential quality regressions. The next follow-up will add automated canary rollouts for quantized variants and expanded telemetry to detect quality regressions on production prompts.
